battle.name: 劉武周起事
battle.brief: 隋大業十三年五月，馬邑劉武周殺隋官王君廓，舉兵反隋自稱漢王，結東突厥精騎攻陷並州、汾州，威脅關中。李淵遣竇抗鎮河東告急，秦王李世民武德四年北征，介休納降將尉遲敬德，復於雀鼠谷、柏谷大破宋金剛，逼劉武周棄並州北走突厥。列陣與騎射所恃者，正是亞述長弓一脈的合成角弓。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 本役是隋末北方割據格局中一場以個人軍事集團為核心的起事戰爭，交戰一方是馬邑出身的劉武周集團，另一方是剛於長安建立的唐朝。劉武周一方起兵於隋大業十三年，先以馬邑為根據地，殺隋方鎮官員王君廓，控有並州（太原）、汾州、介休一帶州縣，並與東突厥可汗庭結盟，藉突厥精騎壯軍力；麾下有宋金剛、尉遲敬德等將領，自稱「漢王」，以漢室名號收攏河東人心。兵源上，劉武周軍以河東、並汾二州的郡兵與義軍為骨幹，攻城與野戰則倚重突厥騎兵以及新附的隋朝降卒與器械。唐一方是李淵於隋大業十三年冬在長安建立的唐朝，中央集權於關中，置並州、汾州等州府，兵制承隋制，以宿衛、府兵、州兵為骨幹，另設行軍總管統兵；李淵先遣竇抗鎮河東，又令齊王李建成出師河東，皆未能扭轉局勢，最終以秦王李世民為北征總帥。隋廷在劉武周起兵時已名存實亡，故本役實質是劉武周集團與唐朝爭奪河東的戰爭。
countriesEn: This was an uprising war fought inside the collapsing northern patchwork of the late Sui, with one side being the military group raised by Liu Wuzhou of Mayi and the other the Tang dynasty, freshly established at Chang'an. Liu Wuzhou's side rose in the thirteenth year of the Daye era, first using Mayi as its base, killing the Sui commandery official Wang Junkuo, seizing the prefectures of Bingzhou (Taiyuan), Fenzhou and Jiexiu, and forming an alliance with the Eastern Turkic khaganate in order to draw on Turkic heavy cavalry. Commanders such as Song Jingang and Yuchi Jingde served under him. He styled himself Prince of Han, borrowing the Han dynastic name to rally the people of Hedong to his side. His troops were built on the levies and volunteer bands of the Bing and Fen prefectures, and relied on Turkic riders, on Sui deserters and on captured Sui equipment for both siege work and field operations. The Tang side was the state Li Yuan had founded at Chang'an in the winter of that same year, centralised at Guanzhong, administering Bingzhou and Fenzhou as ordinary prefectures, and organised on the Sui model with guards, garrison militia and prefectural soldiers as the backbone and with separate travelling commands (xingjun zongguan) for field operations. Li Yuan first sent Dou Kang to hold Hedong and then sent the Prince of Qi, Li Jiancheng, to operate there; neither reversed the situation, and the northern command was finally given to the Prince of Qin, Li Shimin. The Sui court had by then survived in name only, so in substance this was a war between Liu Wuzhou's group and the Tang for the possession of Hedong.
people: 核心人物是劉武周：馬邑人，父劉中立為隋末河東地方豪強，劉武周曾任隋帝宿衛，因結交關內豪族而得家資兵眾，為起事積下本錢。劉武周倚為柱石的大將是宋金剛，善驅輕騎、掠奪糧道，一度令李世民軍中乏食，幾迫使唐軍避戰；原為劉武周部將的尉遲敬德（原名宗，字敬德）則在李世民進至介休時開城降唐，並引導唐軍直取並州，後為唐之名將，以馬槊著稱。被劉武周所殺的隋方鎮官員王君廓，是本役導火線的關鍵人物。唐方以李淵（高祖）居中坐鎮、竇抗（河東行軍總管，兵敗後病故）與李建成（齊王，曾率師與劉武周周旋而無功）為樞紐，統兵北征的是李世民。他在本役中展現了唐初最具影響力的戰將作風：以精騎當鋒、間道疾行、不與敵爭一城一地、以追擊與奇襲破敵，柏谷一戰盡毀宋金剛主力，其後乘勢收復並州。背後的第三方是東突厥始畢可汗，他既援助劉武周，又在其敗亡後將其首級與所部漢人交還唐朝。
peopleEn: The central figure was Liu Wuzhou, a native of Mayi whose father Liu Zhongli was a local magnate in Hedong in the last years of the Sui. Liu Wuzhou had once served as a guard in the Sui imperial household, and through his connections with great families inside the passes he acquired both money and troops, which became the capital of his rising. The mainstay of his army was Song Jingang, whom he relied on as his pillar: Song was skilled at driving light cavalry and cutting supply lines, and at one point left Li Shimin's army so short of food that the Tang troops nearly withdrew from the field. Yuchi Jingde, born Zong and given the style Jingde, had been one of Liu Wuzhou's generals; when Li Shimin reached Jiexiu he opened the city and surrendered, then guided the Tang army straight to Bingzhou, and he would end his days as a famous Tang general remembered for the long spear. The Sui commandery official Wang Junkuo, murdered by Liu Wuzhou, was the spark that set the whole affair off. On the Tang side the key men were Li Yuan, who held the centre at Chang'an; Dou Kang, the travelling commander of Hedong, who was stricken by defeat and died of illness; and Li Jiancheng, Prince of Qi, who campaigned against Liu Wuzhou without achieving anything. The man who actually led the northern expedition was Li Shimin. In this campaign he displayed the most influential generalship of the early Tang: heavy cavalry in front, rapid movement by secret roads, no clinging to any single town, and victory by pursuit and surprise. The battle of Bogue destroyed Song Jingang's main body, and he went on to retake Bingzhou. The third party was the Eastern Turkic khagan Shibi, who had supported Liu Wuzhou and who, after his defeat, handed over his head and the Chinese people he had carried off.
kits: 卡面亞述長弓是公元前七世紀亞述王國的合成角弓，以角片、木胎、筋腱三重組合，張力大、拉距短，亞述弓兵常在車上發射，車隊再由箭雨掩護突進。本役的實戰兵器與此同源：隋唐軍械與河東軍械都屬以角、筋、木合製的短弓體系，即所謂角弓，步卒立射、騎兵踞射，箭為木桿配鐵鏃或骨鏃，有效射程約一百五十至二百步。劉武周起兵時繳獲隋方鎮在馬邑的軍資，器械、戰馬與糧秣多出自官庫；與突厥結盟後，草原式的高弧度騎射也進入河東戰場，騎兵以左右縱馳、連環射擊施壓於騎兵正面。攻城一方用隋代已見的器械：雲梯、巢車、撞車與投石機，用於攻取汾州、並州城池；守軍有塗泥的雉堞、門樓、櫓與拒馬。步戰核心是長槊、馬槊與隋唐直刀，騎兵著札甲、披膊，並備長刀與短兵。車隊與輜重仍循亞述弓兵—車兵的老路徑運作：弓手先射，槊兵隨槊而進，輜重車居中策應，馬車與弓陣始終成對出現。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow on the card is the composite bow of the seventh-century Assyrian kingdom, built from three matched parts: horn plate, wooden core and sinew backing. It had enormous tension and a short draw, and the Assyrian archers on the card shot from their wagons, the chariots advancing under cover of the arrow storm. The weapons actually used in this campaign belong to the same family: Sui and Tang equipment, and the arms of the Hedong forces alike, belonged to the short composite bow system built from horn, sinew and wood, that is to say the so-called horn bow. Infantry shot it standing, cavalry shot it from the saddle, the arrows being wooden shafts with iron or bone heads, and effective range ran to roughly one hundred fifty to two hundred paces. When Liu Wuzhou rose he seized the Sui commandery stores at Mayi, so much of the equipment, the warhorses and the provisions came out of the official depots; and after his alliance with the Turks, the high-arcing steppe style of mounted archery entered the Hedong battlefield, where riders worked the field with wide lateral gallops and repeated volleys. For siege work the age already possessed the devices of the Sui: scaling ladders, siege towers, battering rams and traction trebuchets, used against the walls of Fenzhou and Bingzhou; the defenders had plastered crenellations, gate towers, timber galleries on the walls and cheval-de-frise. The core of close fighting was the long spear, the cavalry lance and the straight Tang blade; armoured horsemen wore lamellar and sleeve armour and carried a long knife and shorter weapons. The baggage train and the vehicles still followed the old Assyrian path of bowman and chariot moving as a pair: the archers shot first, the spearmen advanced behind the shot, the baggage carts moved in the middle as the pivot, horse cart and arrow line always appearing together.
tactics: 劉武周軍的戰法以據城制騎為主：先取並州、汾州城寨為根本，以晉陽城池與汾水為屏障，再用突厥精騎離城出擊、劫掠糧道，攻城時以雲梯、投石同時施壓，逼唐軍不得不在城下爭鋒。宋金剛承擔機動作戰角色，屢率輕騎越過汾水、掠汾晉之穀、抄唐軍糧道，企圖以饑疲逼迫唐軍退兵。唐軍在李世民手中轉為另一套打法：不急於爭一城，專以精騎為鋒、步兵結陣隨行，深入晉陽百里之外，避開宋金剛的騎兵銳鋒；同時遣奇兵封死雀鼠谷一線出口，把宋金剛主力逼入無法展開的谷地。介休之戰中尉遲敬德開城降唐，令劉武周腹背受敵；其後李世民生軍資於其實安營雀鼠谷口不與戰，待敵追至再突然出擊，一日急行二百餘里，於柏谷大破宋金剛，追奔逐北，迫使劉武周放棄並州。糧道管理上，唐軍遠征先靠關中運糧，抵達後留一軍屯兵太原招撫城邑，逐步把糧秣、器械與兵源就地補給。
tacticsEn: The method of Liu Wuzhou's army was to hold the fortified towns and let the horse do the work: first to seize the strongholds of Bingzhou and Fenzhou as a base, using the walls of Jinyang and the Fen River as a screen, and then to send the Turkic heavy cavalry out from the cities to raid and to cut supply lines, while siege ladders and traction trebuchets were worked together against the walls to force the Tang army to fight under the ramparts. Song Jingang was given the mobile role: repeatedly leading light horse across the Fen, sweeping the grain out of the Fen and Jin districts and harrying the Tang supply lines, in the hope that hunger and fatigue would drive the Tang back. Under Li Shimin the Tang fought by a different set of rules: no hurry to contest any one town, the heavy cavalry in front with the infantry formed up in line behind them, pushing a hundred li beyond Jinyang and dodging the sharp edge of Song Jingang's horsemen; at the same time detachments were sent to seal the exit through Quehue Valley, trapping Song Jingang's main body in ground where it could not deploy. At Jiexiu, Yuchi Jingde opened the city and surrendered to the Tang, which caught Liu Wuzhou between two fronts. After that Li Shimin halted with the army in its baggage and encamped at the mouth of Quehue Valley without offering battle, waited for the enemy to come up, and struck out suddenly, covering more than two hundred li in a single day, breaking Song Jingang at Bogue and pursuing the rout, which forced Liu Wuzhou to abandon Bingzhou. On supply, the Tang expedition was fed at first from Guanzhong; once in the field a force was left at Taiyuan to take over the towns and bring provisions, weapons and recruits into local supply.
data: 可考的數字多見於《資治通鑑》與兩《唐書》。劉武周起兵於隋大業十三年五月（617年），同年閏九月攻陷並州，至武德四年（621年）十二月放棄太原北走，前後不足五年。起兵初期兵力為數千人，其後得突厥精騎，人數說法不一，或稱數千騎、或稱萬餘。柏谷之戰，通鑑記唐軍斬首三千餘級、俘虜五萬餘人，收牛馬以萬計，器械稱是，是劉武周軍最大的一次損失。雀鼠谷追擊，記一日行二百餘里、破數十營；介休一役則因尉遲敬德開城而得不戰而定其城。地理上，馬邑（今山西朔州）至並州太原約三百餘里，兩地之間有汾水與雀鼠谷等隘道；太原至洛陽約五百餘公里、一千餘里，是唐軍由關中出兵的最近軸線。需要提醒的是，唐史中的俘虜數字多帶宣傳色彩，柏谷一戰的五萬俘未必等於實數點驗，實際收編人數應遠少於此。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked come mostly from the Comprehensive Mirror and the two Tang histories. Liu Wuzhou rose in the fifth month of the thirteenth year of Daye (617); he took Bingzhou in the intercalary ninth month of that same year, and by the twelfth month of the fourth year of Wude (621) he was abandoning Taiyuan and fleeing north, so the whole affair lasted less than five years. He began with several thousand men and afterwards obtained Turkic heavy cavalry, though the numbers given differ from source to source, some saying several thousand riders and others more than ten thousand. At Bogue the Mirror records 3,000-odd heads cut off and more than 50,000 prisoners taken, with cattle and horses counted by the ten thousand and the armoury stripped bare; this was the heaviest loss Liu Wuzhou's army ever suffered. The pursuit through Quehue Valley is recorded as covering more than two hundred li in a single day and breaking dozens of camps, while the affair at Jiexiu was settled without a battle because Yuchi Jingde opened the gates. Geographically, Mayi, present-day Shuozhou in Shanxi, lies about three hundred li from Bingzhou at Taiyuan, with the Fen River and passes such as Quehue lying between them; Taiyuan to Luoyang is roughly five hundred kilometres, some thousand li, and is the shortest axis on which the Tang could march out of Guanzhong. It should be said that the prisoner figures in the Tang histories carry a strong flavour of proclamation; the fifty thousand taken at Bogue was certainly not a head count, and the number actually enrolled was far smaller.
cause: 起事有其長期與直接兩層原因。長期層面是隋朝末年的崩解：大業年間連年東征高句麗，三征天下河北，租調力役急徵，山西並汾一州民力凋敝、盜賊蜂起，隋廷在馬邑一帶的政令早已虛置，官府威令不出城郭。直接原因則是劉武周與隋方鎮官員王君廓的權力之爭：劉武周以父劉中立留下的馬邑兵眾與家資為資本，又因曾任宿衛而結交關內豪族、得以私募兵眾，勢力已逼近王君廓的郡府；王君廓有意削弱兼併，劉武周遂先發制人，殺王君廓奪取馬邑的兵仗與糧秣，隨即聚眾起兵。此外，北方邊地的權力真空給了突厥可汗庭介入的空間：始畢可汗有意扶持一個漢人軍事集團作為唐朝在河東的對手，藉此削弱唐廷並換取更多財貨與人口，劉武周起事正落在這個縫隙之中。
causeEn: The rising had both a long cause and an immediate one. In the long run the Sui was coming apart: the campaigns against Goguryeo in the Daye years and the repeated levies on Hebei drained the tax and labour of the people, the districts of Bing and Fen in Shanxi were exhausted, bandits rose on every side, and the Sui's authority in the region of Mayi had long since become nominal, the court's orders no longer reaching beyond the city walls. The immediate cause was a struggle for power between Liu Wuzhou and Wang Junkuo, the Sui commandery official. Liu Wuzhou had as his capital the troops and wealth his father Liu Zhongli had accumulated at Mayi, and because he had served in the imperial guard he had made friends with the great families inside the passes and could raise a private force; his strength had already come to threaten Wang Junkuo's administration, and the latter moved to reduce and absorb him. Liu Wuzhou therefore struck first, killed Wang Junkuo, seized the arms and provisions of Mayi, and called his followers together to revolt. In addition, the power vacuum along the northern frontier gave the Turkic khaganate room to intervene: Shibi Khan wanted a Chinese military group to stand against the Tang in Hedong, so as to weaken the Tang court and draw off more wealth and people. Liu Wuzhou's rising fell exactly into that opening.
impact: 本役最直接的後果，是唐朝的河東門戶被打開。劉武周敗亡後，唐得以重據並州、汾州、介休，招募降卒、收繳馬匹器械充實軍力，並節制河東一線，關中根本由此得以外護；同時劉武周覆亡與竇建德被擒、王世充出降在數年間相接，隋末北方諸股割據力量陸續平定，統一大業由此揭幕。對唐初政權本身，李世民因本役確立其統兵威名，隨後得以總領全國兵馬；尉遲敬德等降將的歸附，也把河東與關中的武力重新編入唐的軍籍。邊疆層面上，劉武周遺下的勢力成為東突厥與唐朝衝突的新來源，突厥屢次南下寇太原、嵐州，其所掠山西人口的歸還成為雙方交涉的焦點，貞觀初年唐廷遂以重兵鎮並州、築城屯田應對。從長期看，這場起事只是隋末亂局中的一環，但它把河東的歸屬問題一次性攤開，決定了唐初兵力投放的優先次序。
impactEn: The most direct consequence of the campaign was that Tang's door into Hedong was forced open. After Liu Wuzhou's fall the Tang reoccupied Bingzhou, Fenzhou and Jiexiu, enlisted the deserters, and took over horses and equipment to fill out its forces, while holding the Hedong line; the root of Guanzhong was thereafter guarded from the outside. At the same time the destruction of Liu Wuzhou came within a few years of the capture of Dou Jiande and the surrender of Wang Shichong, so the northern separatist powers of the late Sui were extinguished one after another and the work of reunification could begin. For the early Tang state itself, Li Shimin established his reputation as a commander in this campaign and afterwards held command of the empire's forces; the accession of deserters such as Yuchi Jingde also folded the fighting men of Hedong and Guanzhong back into Tang's order of battle. On the frontier, the forces Liu Wuzhou left behind became a new source of friction between the Eastern Turks and the Tang; the Turks raided Taiyuan and Lanzhou repeatedly, and the return of the Shanxi people they had carried off became a standing subject of negotiation, so that in the early Zhenguan years the court concentrated troops at Bingzhou, built walls and set up tuntian to meet the threat. In the long run this rising was only one link in the late Sui disorder, but it laid the question of Hedong's ownership on the table once and for all, and settled the priority order in which the early Tang distributed its troops.
result: 唐軍在雀鼠谷、柏谷連續殲滅宋金剛主力之後，劉武周於武德四年十二月放棄並州，率殘部北走突厥。唐軍乘勢取並州，招降周邊二十餘城，留一軍屯兵太原接收降眾，尉遲敬德引導唐軍入城，河東的城寨重新掛上唐的旗號。劉武周抵達突厥牙帳後不久被突厥所殺，首級傳送長安，其殘眾或散歸草原、或降於唐。自稱「漢王」的短命政權自隋大業十三年五月起事到武德四年末覆亡，歷時四年有餘，兵鋒終止於馬邑與並州之間。戰役之後，唐廷得以把重心轉向洛陽與河北；而劉武周留下的裝備存量——大量隋朝制式角弓、鐵鏃、札甲與馬匹——成為唐軍重建河東防線的現成物資。宋金剛其後下落諸史不一，或云隨武周入蕃，或云為武周所疑殺，尉遲敬德則以唐之名將的身份善終。
resultEn: After the Tang had destroyed Song Jingang's main body in succession at Quehue Valley and at Bogue, Liu Wuzhou abandoned Bingzhou in the twelfth month of the fourth year of Wude and led his remnants north to the Turks. The Tang followed him into the city, induced more than twenty surrounding towns to surrender, left a force at Taiyuan to receive the defectors, and with Yuchi Jingde guiding them took the capital of Hedong; the fortresses of the region flew Tang banners once more. Liu Wuzhou was killed by the Turks not long after he reached their camp, and his head was sent to Chang'an; his remaining followers either scattered onto the steppe or surrendered to the Tang. The short-lived regime that called itself the Prince of Han lasted a little over four years, from the rising in the fifth month of the thirteenth year of Daye to its end in the last months of the fourth year of Wude, and its advance finally stopped between Mayi and Bingzhou. After the campaign the Tang court was free to shift its weight towards Luoyang and the north; and the stock of equipment Liu Wuzhou left behind, large quantities of Sui-pattern composite bows, iron arrowheads, lamellar armour and horses, became ready material for rebuilding the Tang line in Hedong. The later fate of Song Jingang is reported differently from source to source, some saying he followed Liu Wuzhou among the Turks, others that Liu killed him on suspicion; Yuchi Jingde, by contrast, lived out his career as a famous general of the Tang.
